description: Comprehensive example showing all available configuration options
_comment_locale: System locale/region settings (e.g., en-US, de-DE, ja-JP)
_comment_timezone: Windows timezone (e.g., 'Pacific Standard Time', 'Eastern Standard Time', 'UTC')
_comment_keyboard: Keyboard layout code in format 'LanguageID:KeyboardID' (0409:00000409 = US English)
_comment_userAccount: Default user account created automatically during installation

userAccount._comment_password: Password for the default account (plain text - will be hashed during install)

_comment_privacy: Privacy settings to control data collection and user tracking

privacy._comment_disableAppSuggestions: Disable app suggestions and ads in Start menu/notifications/lockscreen (HKCU ContentDeliveryManager)
privacy._comment_disableTelemetry: Disable Windows telemetry and diagnostic data collection
privacy._comment_disableCopilot: Disable Windows Copilot AI assistant (HKCU WindowsCopilot\TurnOffWindowsCopilot)

security._comment_disableUac: Disable User Account Control prompts (HKLM Policies\System\EnableLUA) - NOT RECOMMENDED for security
security._comment_disableSmartScreen: Disable Windows SmartScreen filter for apps/files/websites (HKLM Explorer\SmartScreenEnabled)
security._comment_disableVirtualizationBasedSecur: Disable VBS/HVCI (memory integrity) - improves performance but reduces security (HKLM DeviceGuard)
security._comment_preventDeviceEncryption: Prevent automatic BitLocker device encryption (HKLM BitLocker\PreventDeviceEncryption)
security._comment_bypassRequirementsCheck: Bypass TPM 2.0, Secure Boot, and RAM requirements for Windows 11 installation (HKLM Setup\LabConfig)

_comment_ui: User interface appearance and behavior settings

ui._comment_showFileExtensions: Show file extensions in File Explorer (HKCU Explorer\Advanced\HideFileExt = 0)
ui._comment_hideFiles: Hidden file visibility: 'none' (show all), 'hidden' (hide hidden), 'hiddenSystem' (hide hidden+system)
ui._comment_taskbarSearch: Taskbar search box appearance: 'hide', 'icon', 'box', or 'label' (HKCU Search\SearchboxTaskbarMode)
ui._comment_disableWidgets: Disable widgets/news and interests on taskbar (HKLM Policies\Dsh\AllowNewsAndInterests)
ui._comment_launchToThisPC: Open File Explorer to 'This PC' instead of 'Quick Access' (HKCU Explorer\Advanced\LaunchTo = 1)
ui._comment_disableWindowsConsumerFeatures: Disable consumer features: app suggestions, tips, ads, etc. (HKLM CloudContent\DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures)
ui._comment_emptyStartPins: Remove all pinned items from Start menu (sets ConfigureStartPins to empty JSON)
ui._comment_disableBingResults: Disable Bing web results in Windows Search (HKCU Explorer\DisableSearchBoxSuggestions)
ui._comment_disableStickyKeys: Disable Sticky Keys accessibility feature that triggers with 5x Shift press (HKCU Accessibility\StickyKeys)

performance._comment_enableLongPaths: Enable NTFS long path support >260 characters for modern apps (HKLM FileSystem\LongPathsEnabled)
performance._comment_disableFastStartup: Disable fast startup/hybrid shutdown - improves dual-boot compatibility (HKLM Power\HiberbootEnabled = 0)
performance._comment_disableSystemRestore: Disable System Restore to save disk space (removes restore points)
performance._comment_disableWindowsUpdate: Disable automatic Windows Update installation - NOT RECOMMENDED for security

_comment_development: Settings for developers and power users

development._comment_allowPowerShellScripts: Set PowerShell execution policy to RemoteSigned to allow local script execution

browser._comment_hideEdgeFre: Hide Edge First Run Experience welcome screen (HKLM Policies\Edge\HideFirstRunExperience)
browser._comment_disableEdgeStartupBoost: Disable Edge startup boost and background processes (HKLM Policies\Edge\StartupBoostEnabled = 0)

bloatware._comment_removePackages: AppxPackages (UWP apps) to remove - reduces disk usage and clutter
bloatware._comment_removeCapabilities: Windows capabilities (optional components) to remove - frees disk space

_comment_scripts: Custom PowerShell scripts to execute during installation phases

scripts._comment_bootstrapScript: Path to bootstrap PowerShell script to execute (relative to preset file or absolute path)

passwordPolicy._comment_maxPasswordAge: Maximum password age: 'unlimited' or number of days before password expires
